Method of Attack: Malware infection via compromised CCleaner app versions
First stage malware Floxif installed via infected CCleaner 5.33.6162
Second-stage payload (backdoor) delivered selectively to targeted computers
Impacted Systems: 1,646,536 computers infected with Floxif first stage malware
Networks of Chunghwa Telecom, NEC, Samsung, ASUS, Fujitsu, Sony, IPAddress.com, O2, Gauselmann, Singtel, Intel, VMWare
Attack Vector: Compromised official CCleaner software downloads between August 15 and September 12, 2017
Command and Control (C&C) servers used to control infected hosts and deliver second-stage payload
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses of C&C servers: 216.126.225.148 and 216.126.225.163
Malicious CCleaner versions: 5.33.6162 (infected), 5.34 and 1.07.3214 (clean versions released after incident)
PHP code and myPhpAdmin logs on C&C servers
Backup database of infected hosts from C&C servers
